defaultModelNote: The model used when neither the call nor OLLAMA_MODEL names one. It is the model Ollama's own quickstart runs first (`ollama run gemma4:e2b`, docs.ollama.com/quickstart): 128K context, tools, vision and thinking (ollama.com/library/gemma4). It replaced llama3.2:latest.
fallbackModelNote: The model suggested when the requested one is not installed. Same as defaultModel: the model Ollama's own quickstart runs first (`ollama run gemma4:e2b`, docs.ollama.com/quickstart). It replaced two disagreeing copies in code: llama3.1:8b (client.ts) and llama3.2:latest (constants.ts).

timeout.message: Ollama request timed out. The model may be loading or the request is too large.

rules.message: Cannot connect to Ollama at {baseURL}. Install Ollama (https://ollama.com), start it with 'ollama serve', then try again.
Ollama model '{model}' is not available locally. Pull it first with 'ollama pull {model}' (or try '{fallbackModel}'); list installed models with 'ollama list'.
Ollama returned HTTP 404 from {baseURL}. Verify the base URL serves the OpenAI-compatible /v1 API and that the model is installed ('ollama list').
